name: Nodal Theme Switcher
author: xft0729
desc: Whole-app themes for Nodal — switch the editor (toolbar, panels, menu bar) between 13 workbench themes plus 12 canvas map presets.
longDesc: Theme Switcher ships 13 whole-app editor themes (Nodal Light, Nodal Dark, Midnight, Forest, Crimson Line, Violet Night, Deep Teal, Solar Paper, Lavender, Mint, Sky, Rose, High Contrast) and 12 canvas map presets (Classic Light, Nodal Dark, Tokyo Neon, London Underground, Taipei Metro, NYC Subway, Retro Blueprint, Minimal Mono, High-Contrast Print, Ocean Depth, Sunset Transit, Pastel Dream). App themes are CSS variables for tokens.css (persist via localStorage); map themes are pure MetroMap→MetroMap transforms (undo-safe via Nodal Command). Import/export works with plain JSON files and the CLI.
features: 12 map style presets (background, grid, corner radius, station size, typography, label colour)
Cycled line palettes per theme (London, NYC, Taipei, Tokyo, …) — recolours all lines deterministically
13 whole-app editor themes as CSS variables (drop-in tokens.css overrides, persists to localStorage)
Pure, undo-safe transforms: applyMapTheme() + makeApplyThemeCommand() for Nodal CommandStack
Detect closest preset, export current style, validate & import custom theme JSON
CLI: nodal-theme list | apply-map | export-theme | detect
Zero runtime dependencies — runs in browser and Node
MIT licensed, TypeScript strict, tested with Vitest
